independent_input_declaration.rules_authority: Original printed 2017 booklet, all nine species fronts, Faderan reverse, accepted component scans and direct original2017 designer articles only. Module metadata used only for lineage; no scripts/behavior consulted.
independent_input_declaration.note: Allowed current coverage-map contains embedded historical stopping fields; those claims were ignored as evidence of completeness.

source_key.reason: All 86 entries and 256 required atoms supported by assigned original authority; same-entry expected/contextual assertions also checked. Concrete results agree with native printed symbols and official original author clarifications.

exact_asked_scope.reason: Required facts resolve actual clauses. Context-only formulas, explanations, remaining unchanged states and unasked quantities are not omission criteria. Concrete applications satisfy underlying branches without separately narrated derivations.

coverage_stopping.reason: Independent full-source challenge found no remaining distinct consequential procedure, condition or outcome requiring a new question under the stipulated novelty standard. Stopping is based on source units below, not the map’s historical pass count or any target question number.

source_wide_reasoning.reasoning: Reviewed complete overview/components and card diagrams, including symbol-based entry, private points, public resources/cards, interchangeability, shortage independence, colony flipping and printed cost/output meaning. Q03,Q18,Q21,Q23,Q25–29,Q57,Q65,Q76,Q81,Q85 exercise consequential rules. Component quantities, lore and rough-value memorization are outside novelty.

Read setup text and complete tabletop spread. Q21–22,Q69,Q79 test species choice/start state, library, randomization and orientation, deal eligibility, actual-count tracks with Kjas exception, era stack and first Trade. Colony initial dealing lowest minimum upward is same track-dealing procedure exercised on research by Q22; changing deck identity alone adds no distinct branch.

Q01–07,Q24–28,Q31,Q51,Q56–57,Q67–69,Q76,Q84–85 cover simultaneity, binding consent/contingency, compensation alternatives, penalties, loans, invention, both upgrade routes, renamed cards, support deadline, optional/once/no-input converters, no chaining, donation disposal and wild/color/climate rules. Recommended physical production layout is not a legal precondition. Concrete penalty and interest cases exercise tariffs/matching without requiring narrated formulas.

Q08–10,Q29–31,Q55,Q58–61,Q66,Q70–72,Q79,Q82–83 cover sharing/access/bonus, era IV, both hidden bids and reserves, full payment/passes/minima/ties, limited bid negotiation, cleanup, loans, turn counter, scoring categories and winner. Native page10 contains flavor/advice and credits, not additional procedural exceptions. Optional timed trading, handicapping and precise scoring excluded.

All Halved Bids, Seedling Tokens and upgrade timing paragraphs checked. Q11,Q32–34,Q63 cover fractions/minimum/research distinction, token grant/non-grant and persistence/removal, twice production without chaining and unchanged upgrade cost. Advice does not impose additional legal requirements.

Q12,Q35,Q52 cover own-interest prohibition, permission to upgrade, single-color restriction, upgraded non-growth and both mixed/entirely-wild branches. Counting different colors/sizes in another ordinary example adds no rule.

source_wide_reasoning.unit: Faderan front and reverse, accepted relic components
source_wide_reasoning.reasoning: Q13–14,Q36–43,Q62,Q74,Q81 cover acknowledgment actor, compulsory return/reward, hidden shuffled deck, one back converter, top immediate entry, ordinary relic loans through Q03 and Detector exception, Network support, Cache entry/cost/mandatory/octagon branches, Paradise, Star’s Ruin, Gift, Grindstone and Decomposer simultaneity through Q06. Network numeric support is contextual, not separately credited as asked; it is ordinary printed support magnitude, not an uncovered procedure. Other ordinary entry points and input/output quantities are rejected as card memorization.
Q15,Q21,Q37,Q44 cover fleet support splitting/combining/symbols/loans, discovery and starred start, colony restriction and explicit Network exception. Advice is not a rule.

Q16,Q21–22,Q45,Q53,Q80,Q86 cover split decision timing, near-equal allocation, later ranks, no resplit, per-half minimum/payment/pass and changed holdings, double colony count only, territory entry/flip/loans and both economic converters. Distinct explicit both-converter permission is actually asked in Q86.

Q17,Q46,Q64 cover fixed pair/independent flip/loan, nullspace entry without output, permanence/removal, unlimited support and colony tie override with normal research counts then infinity. Strategy suggestions add no legal branch.

Q18,Q35,Q47,Q65 test gray substitution, same-size input including gray/mixed colors, immunity, Eni pass-through, any-climate colony use, support deadline and computer-world entry. Additional computer-world resource costs are ordinary printed inputs.

Q19,Q48,Q59 cover withholding, incoming shared cards, private splay, research count exclusion, reduced bonus and licensing same Trade/permanent own card/no restoration. Different license price negotiation is free Trade, already Q85.

Q20,Q49–50,Q54,Q61,Q73,Q75,Q77–78 cover red theft timing, final action, one target and no repeated target, available shortfall, size/shape versus color, target-held envoy discounts without spending, immunity, factory bundled token output and stash/recipient restrictions, actual-trade protection versus gifts. Vulnerable/Safe tokens are a tracking aid rather than an extra legal condition.
